description: Consumes the Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management adaptive protection signal exposed to Conditional Access. Blocks sign-ins from workforce users currently elevated to the high adaptive insider risk tier (e.g., users exfiltrating large volumes after a triggering HR event). Requires Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management configured with adaptive protection enabled, plus Entra ID P2 (and the Purview licensing prerequisites) on the in-scope users. Pair with CA103b (high sign-in risk) and CA102 (high user risk) for a layered identity + insider risk response.
